name: g70_skillswap_illusion
purpose: Skill Swap at an Illusion holder (issue #620; decisions 0041 and 0026; decision 0015 entry 5dx): Zoroark (M) leads disguised as Gholdengo (the last brought member to its right). Turn 1 Gardevoir (F) aims Skill Swap at it while the disguise is up; Illusion has failskillswap (data/abilities.ts:2091), so the swap fails: -fail with [still] on the move line, no ability changes hands, the disguise stays. Turn 2 the faster Espeon's Dazzling Gleam breaks the disguise (Focus Sash holds Zoroark at 1 HP), and Gardevoir's Skill Swap at the shown Zoroark fails again.
